heading: Footprint, not timing, is what's saved
text:
### Footprint, not timing, is what's saved [LNRE.4.3]

Omitting an RE2-class engine reduces the compiled runtime image's
static size — the matching engine's code, tables, and Unicode data are
never linked in. It changes no T_wcet term ([LNRE.1.1]): a regex-less
build does not run a regex-carrying DSC faster, it simply cannot run
one at all ([LNRE.4.1]).

This is a different kind of payoff from every other registered
capability ([LCAP.1]), each of which trades an authoring constraint for
an allocation or algorithmic-shape guarantee. `regex: false` trades it for a
build-time property of the runtime artifact instead.
